newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Comalco sees 1997 aluminium demand up.
newsitem.headline: Comalco sees 1997 aluminium demand up.

text.p: Alumina, bauxite and aluminium producer Comalco Ltd said on Thursday it expected demand for aluminium to increase slightly in calendar 1997.
"Demand for primary aluminium is expected to rise slightly and experience in the first two months of 1997 confirms this," the company said in its 1996 annual report.
Comalco said the transport sector was the most rapidly expanding end user for aluminium.
Bauxite demand was seen largely unchanged this year, while alumina prices were expected to improve from the low levels experienced in 1996, Comalco said.
Comalco, 67 percent owned by global mining group RTZ-CRA, posted pre-abnormal net profits of A$32.9 million in 1996 from A$264.8 million a year earlier.
"In the short term, Comalco's focus will be on sustained cost reduction and implementing a low cost culture throughout the organisation," it said in the annual report.
